data.desc: Headquartered in Aliso Viejo, CA, indie is accelerating ADAS intelligence across automotive, quantum, and Physical AI applications through next-generation hardware, system solutions, and perception software technologies. By developing high-performance, energy-efficient semiconductor, photonic, and software solutions, we are enabling machines to perceive, understand, and interact with the physical world. Spanning radar, computer vision, LiDAR, and ultrasound, our platforms power advanced safety, automation, positioning, and automated capabilities for leading automotive OEMs, intelligent machines, and emerging AI-driven systems worldwide.
